cast.HERO: lean masked hero, dark suit, white chest emblem, white eye lenses
cast.THUGS: three bulky street thugs in hoodies
cast.SERPENT: colossal armoured serpent, fanged head, coils through the street

panels.draw: Wide skyline across a river at dusk, low sun, bridge on the right, horizon on the lower third.
Street-level canyon of towers and billboards, crowds and cars, strong one-point perspective.
Hero's masked head and shoulder fill the left third, looking right toward the skyline.
Looking up past a rooftop edge as the hero launches overhead, towers leaning in, arrow down-right.
Side-on, hero stretched out left to right on a swing line, speed lines, street far below.
Top-down over a busy avenue, hero diving along the lanes toward camera, cars below.
Hero from behind at left in a crouch facing three thugs spread across a wet street, van at right.
Hero's punch connects with a thug's jaw, impact burst, the thug's head snapping back right.
Hero small in frame arcing between towers, trajectory arrow, billboards on both sides.
Serpent rears over the street with open jaws, tiny hero in the foreground centre for scale.
Low angle, the serpent's head strikes down at the hero who dodges right, debris flying.
Two-shot: hero crouched at left, hooded ally crouched at right, serpent coils behind them.
